card.name: Titles and links in reference lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small words inside citation titles or URLs in reference lists, such as the colon, comma or 'for' within a cited title, right before the next title word.

modes.label: Title punctuation
modes.description: A colon, comma or quote mark inside a cited work's title in a bibliography entry.
modes.example: Husing T., Selhofer H. (2004), DIDIX<<:>> a Digital Divide Index for measuring inequality in

modes.label: Small words in titles
modes.description: A short word such as 'for', 'Is' or 'a' inside a cited title.
modes.example: Seven Essentials<< for>> Project-Based Learning John Larmer and John

modes.label: URL pieces
modes.description: A number or path piece inside a web address cited as a source.

card.writes: It slightly boosts word-ending pieces like 'ering' and 'ered', which suggests no clear next-word effect.
card.plain: It fires on punctuation and small words inside titles and web addresses in citation lists.
